How to create a Facebook QR code

You only need the link to the page you want people to open.

  1. Open your Facebook page, profile or group in a browser and copy the address from the address bar.
  2. Paste it into the field above.
  3. Choose your colors, and add a logo or a frame with text like "Follow us".
  4. Download the PNG or SVG.
  5. Scan the finished code with a phone and check that it opens the right page. Try it on a phone that is not logged in to check what strangers see.

What can a Facebook QR code point to?

Choose the destination based on what you want visitors to do.

DestinationLink looks likeBest for
Business pagefacebook.com/yourpageFollows, reviews, updates

Messenger chatm.me/yourpageQuestions, bookings, support
An eventfacebook.com/events/...Invitations and RSVPs
A post or albumLink to the postPhotos and announcements

Send people to Messenger

If you want conversations rather than followers, use your Messenger link, which is the m.me address followed by your page name. Scanning it opens a chat with your page. It is a good fit for small shops that take questions and orders by message.

Tips before you print

A few checks prevent dead ends.

  • Check privacy. A private group or a restricted page will show a login or a request screen. Use a public page for cold audiences.
  • Use your page URL, not a temporary one. Set a clean page username so the address stays short.
  • Give a reason to scan, such as "Scan for offers".
  • Test on a phone not signed in to see what a new visitor sees.
  • Keep the code about 1 inch (2.5 cm) or larger.
